quote: Subject to the required approvals, Salar Futuro represents the next stage in the transformation of our operations in Chile. The project contemplates an estimated capital investment of approximately US$3 billion, to be deployed over approximately seven years following receipt of the required approvals, with the most capital-intensive phase currently expected during the third and fourth years of development.
note: Opened SQM SEC 6-K English earnings release 2026-10-04; Salar Futuro ~USD 3bn confirmed.
